items.body: The manifest requirement covers newly published artifacts but leaves reused, uncommitted artifacts unspecified. A close can publish the report and then fail before any lifecycle write. On retry, the artifact already exists and is reused. Existing `make-pr-preflight.sh:217–225` stages and commits only `modified_paths`, so following the stated manifest rule can commit a closed spec whose referenced report remains untracked. This defeats durable recording on the explicitly supported retry path.
items.suggestion: Require every successful new closure to include its validated artifact in the commit manifest, including reused artifacts. Add a control that fails after artifact publication but before lifecycle writes, retries through the close/commit fence, and verifies that the committed tree contains the referenced bytes.

items.body: The blanket assertion that preflight invokes no network fetch conflicts with existing behavior that this plan preserves. `make-pr-preflight.sh:22` refreshes an explicit branch base, and line 43 refreshes a detected remote base. A harness recording the full preflight command sequence will therefore reject valid existing behavior.
items.suggestion: Scope the prohibition to additional network operations introduced by validation-review handling, or assert it within the spec-close fence.
